description_en: This non-existing rest house was constructed by a person named Dharaṇīdhara in 1694 CE (NS 814). Only a small shrine of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa remains at the center of the square pavilion where the Phalcā once stood.The statue of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa faces west towards Umāmaheśvara Mandira (KIR0006) while the inscription recording the construction of the Phalcā is set on the rear wall of the shrine. The inscription states that Dharaṇīdhara, who constructed the Phalcā in 1694 CE, was a resident of Kirtipur and held the post of the chief of the fort. The fort probably is a reference to the city of Kirtipur. It further mentions that the Phalcā’s architecture was similar to Kaṣṭhamaṇḍapa of Kathmandu. The donor also endowed sevenropanīs of land to form aguthifor performing various rituals throughout the year (Shokoohy and others2014, p. 94). The Phalcā is due to be reconstructed in traditional architecture with funds from the US embassy.The statue of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa exudes the emotion of love, as the four-armed Nārāyaṇa is seen in amorous disposition, embracing his consort Lakṣmī while slightly bending towards her. Locals, therefore, call the deity ‘Khyālidyaḥ’, the deity of love. There is a local belief that worshipping Khyālidyaḥ brings the person’s love affair to a successful conclusion.The inscription also instructs concerned persons to organize thehāthuhāyketradition. This proves that the tradition of discharging fermented beer (thvã) from the Bhairava mask (Hāthudyaḥ) existed here. This tradition is no longer in practice.
description_ne: हाल अस्तित्वमा नरहेको यस फल्चा परिसरमा लक्ष्मीनारायणको एक मूर्ति राखिएको छ । क्वाःच्व देगः पनि भनिने कीर्तिपुरको उमामहेश्वर मन्दिर अगाडि (पूर्वमा) रहेको यस फल्चाको क्षेत्र अहिले खुला छोडिएको छ ।फल्चा रहेको स्थानमा हाल (अगष्ट सन् २०२२) इटाको सानो देवल बनाई लक्ष्मीनारायणको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । मूर्तिलाई उमामहेश्वर मन्दिर (पश्चिम) तिर फर्काइएको छ भने देवलको पूर्वी भित्तामा अभिलेख राखिएको छ । उक्त अभिलेखमा नेसं ८१४ मा कीर्तिपुर निवासी क्वाथ प्रमुख धरणिधरले काष्ठमण्डप शैलीमा फल्चा बनाएको उल्लेख छ । साथै नियमित र वर्ष भरिका पूजाहरू संचालन गर्न सात रोपनी जग्गा पनि राखिएको थियो (Shokoohy and others2014, p.94) । फल्चाको पुनःनिर्माणार्थ हालै क्षमापूजा पनि गरिएको थियो । अमेरिकी राजदुतावासको आर्थिक सहयोगबाट परम्परागत शैलीमा फल्चाको पुनःनिर्माण हुने भएको छ ।यहाँ प्राप्त अभिलेखका अनुसार नेसं ८१४ (सन् १६९४) मा क्वाथ प्रमुख (किल्लाका नाइके) धरणिधरले लक्ष्मीनारायणको मूर्ति सहित काष्ठमण्डप शैलीको वर्गाकार फल्चा स्थापना गरिएको थियो । यहाँ स्थापित लक्ष्मीनारायणको मूर्तिमा मनोरोम भाव देख्न सकिन्छ । चार हात भएका नारायणले आफ्नो बाँया हात लक्ष्मीको कुममा राखेका छन् भने शरीर थोरै लक्ष्मीतिर झुकाएका छन् । कलाकारले मूर्तिका प्रेम भाव दर्शाउन मेहेनत गरेको देख्न सकिन्छ । यहि कारण कीर्तिपुरवासीहरू यस मूर्तिलाई ख्यालिद्यः (प्रेमको देवता) भन्ने गर्छन् । ख्यालिद्यःको दर्शन गर्नाले प्रेम सफल हुन्छ भन्ने जनविश्वास रहेको छ ।फल्चा अस्तित्वमा रहेको बेला यहाँहाथु हाय्‌केगुचलन पनि रहेको उक्त अभिलेखबाट स्पष्ट हुन्छ । विगतमासमयबजिदान दिने रहाथु हाय्‌केगुसंस्कृति भएतापनि हाल यहाँ यस्ता कुनै कृयाकलाप हुने गरेको छैन ।

historical_events.event_description: Kvātha Nāyaka (chief of fort) Dharaṇidhara constructed the Phalcā in the style similar to Kaṣṭhamanḍapa of Kathmandu.
A statue of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa was also installed during the construction of the Phalcā by Kvātha Nāyaka (chief of fort) Dharaṇidhara.
Sevenropanīsof land were endowed to perform the annual and daily worships.

historical_events.event_name: Preliminary worship for the Phalcā’s reconstruction
historical_events.event_description: Preliminary worship (kṣamāpuja) was performed at the site ahead of the commencement of the Phalcā’s restoration due to take place with the financial assistance of the US Embassy. The ‘Khyālidyaḥ Saṃrakṣaṇa Guthi’, an association of the locals formed for the conservation of Khyālidyaḥ, and the Kirtipur Municipality are also involved in the reconstruction of the Phalcā that will also see the seismic strengthening of the Phalcā pavilion.
